coding_context.description: The magnitude of the startle response following an error is correlated to the amplitude of the Error-Related Negativity (ERN)
coding_context.reported_success_quote: While we were clearly able to replicate the basic ERN and EPS results, the main result ofthe original study was the correlation between the two. The correlation in our replication trended in the same direction as that of the original study, but did not reach the p < .05 threshold for significance. For this reason, we consider this to be a failure to replicate but with extremely similar results.
